name: application-action-sheet
title: Action Sheet
description: Mobile-style bottom action sheet: a grouped list of actions in one rounded card, plus a separated Cancel button, with support for a destructive action.
useWhen: Offering a small set of contextual actions on an item (a photo, message, or file) in a mobile or touch-first layout.
You want the native iOS/Android action-sheet convention: one grouped card of actions plus a separated Cancel.
A destructive action (delete, remove) should be visually distinguished within the same list.
avoidWhen: The layout is desktop-first with a mouse — use a dropdown or context menu instead of a bottom sheet.
There are more than about 5-6 actions — split into a fuller drawer or menu with scrolling and grouping.
The action list needs icons or descriptions per item — this pattern is intentionally text-only and compact; use command-menu-result-row instead for richer rows.
responsiveBehavior: The sheet is a fixed max-w-sm column anchored to the bottom of its container by your own positioning; it fills available width up to that cap.
accessibility: The action list uses role="dialog" with an aria-label describing what the actions apply to.
The destructive action is marked with red text as a visual cue in addition to its position in the list, not as the only signal.
Cancel is a full-width, clearly separated button so it can't be confused with the actions above it.

variants.title: Action sheet
variants.description: Four grouped actions (including a destructive Delete) in a rounded card, with a separated Cancel button below.
accessibility: Each action and Cancel are real full-width buttons, giving large touch targets.

variants.title: Action sheet (Dark)
variants.description: Action sheet adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Destructive-action and divider colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
